profit_quality.assessment: Low confidence distributable-cash denominator. Reported 2024 parent profit was RMB65.979m, but profit before tax included RMB35.563m bank interest income, RMB24.621m VAT additional deduction and other non-core gains. Three-year FCF after capex was RMB-41.427m, RMB-54.511m and RMB376.984m; the strong 2024 cash flow was mainly supported by large increases in trade payables and other payables/contract liabilities.
adjustments: Use RMB20m as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit rather than reported RMB65.979m net profit, because core LCD module manufacturing profit is thin after selling/admin expenses and relies on other income.
Apply 0.25 profit haircut because the business requires continuing capital expenditure, has large working-capital swings, and 2024 OCF was lifted by supplier/customer credit.
Exclude bank interest income from the operating profit base because the related funds assets are separately valued in detachable cash.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Manufacturing margins are thin, capex is persistent and cash conversion depends heavily on working capital and related-party/supplier credit.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 reported OCF is not used at face value because the cash inflow is dominated by payables and advances rather than stable free cash generation.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; recent annual PPE and intangible purchases were around RMB152m-RMB171m.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 receivables and inventory absorbed RMB640.608m, offset by RMB1,022.848m increase in trade payables and other payables/accruals.
